title: Rotate an Array by K Positions (Left and Right)

parameters.name: arr
parameters.description: Pointer to the array to rotate

parameters.name: n
parameters.description: Number of elements in the array

constraints: 0 <= k (may be larger than n — normalize with k % n)
Elements can be any valid int32_t value
Must rotate in-place with O(1) auxiliary space
Handle edge cases: k=0, k=n, k>n, single-element array
